title: Ranchi Student Leader Dropped Hunger Strike After Video Call with Sonechuk
summary: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto dropped his hunger strike in Ranchi after a video call with Sonechuk. The strike was over issues with the exam system at Jaypal Singh Mundas Stadium. Devendra Nath Mahto had set a condition that he would end the strike only if Sonechuk attended. After repeated appeals, Mahto agreed to drink water and promised to attend Sonechuk soon.
summary_points: Devendra Nath Mahto dropped his hunger strike in Ranchi after a video call with Sonechuk.
The strike was over issues with the exam system at Jaypal Singh Mundas Stadium.

After repeated appeals, Mahto agreed to drink water and promised to attend Sonechuk soon.

center: केंद्रीय समाचार एजेंसियां इस घटना पर अनशन और जयपाल सिंह मुंडास स्टेडियम में परीक्षा प्रणाली के बीच संबंध को ध्यान में रखती हैं।
